tiktok.creative_rules: 9:16 vertical ONLY. Lo-fi UGC authentic feel — NOT polished. Bold Impact font text overlays. Leave top 15% and bottom 20% clear for TikTok UI. Casual conversational tone. Raw unfiltered aesthetic. NO corporate design. Feels like a friend filmed this on their phone.

meta.creative_rules: 4:5 portrait preferred for maximum mobile visibility. Scroll-stopping visual with bold sans-serif typography. Leave 15% bottom margin safe zone. Brand-consistent colors. NO Shop Now buttons. Design for saves, shares, and comment tags.

youtube.creative_rules: 16:9 landscape for community posts. High contrast colors that pop at small sizes. Bold condensed typography (3-6 words max). Clean uncluttered composition. Discussion-sparking visual. NO sales language.

pinterest.creative_rules: 2:3 vertical tall pin format. Aspirational vision-board aesthetic. Clean text overlay with serif or elegant sans-serif fonts. Step-by-step guides and numbered lists perform best. Soft muted tones or bold high-contrast. Think inspiration discovery — save-worthy.

instagram.creative_rules: 4:5 portrait for feed posts. Feed-cohesive curated aesthetic. Bold sans-serif typography (Inter/Montserrat style). Pastel-to-bold gradients trending 2025. Personality forward. NO CTA buttons. Think save-worthy — content people bookmark.

facebook.creative_rules: 4:5 portrait for mobile news feed. Community-first shareable design. Clear readable text at smaller preview sizes. Warm approachable tone. Design for shares and comment tags. Avoid overly Gen-Z aesthetics — broader demographic.

x.creative_rules: 16:9 landscape for maximum tweet preview. High-contrast bold opinionated design. Minimal text — one sharp statement. Dark mode friendly. Meme-adjacent aesthetic. Think quote-tweet bait — retweet-worthy.
